newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold eases marginally, silver weaker.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold eases marginally, silver weaker.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat closed Wednesday five rupees lower at 4,760 rupees per 10 gramme against the previous close but up five rupees from the open as some seasonal wedding demand emerged.
** Prices of gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) closed steady at 55,700 rupees per piece after opening 100 rupees lower compared to the previous close of 55,700 rupees.
** Silver (.999) closed 30 rupees lower at 6,850 rupees per kg against the previous close of 6,880 rupees as setback in world market dragged local prices downward.
